events.description: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel (Peyton Elizabeth Lee) launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay), Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover the strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood's fragile future, she will have to risk everything.

events.description: A supernatural night out! Join dark historian Andrew Johnston of Alternative Ulstours on the ultimate walking tour of haunted Belfast! Come explore the city after hours and reawaken its eerie inhabitants... Ghostly adversaries locked in Belfast's first library Grotesque formations of Belfast's gas ghoul Phantom footsteps in a forgotten Belfast morgue Eternal screams from Belfast's damned match factory The broken-hearted spirit bound to Smithfield Market A sensational shadow of the Smithfield mill disaster The 'legless' horror stalking Royal Avenue Fiery apparitions from the ashes of Belfast Castle The executed rebel patrolling a city centre shop The sad spectre of Belfast's tormented 'Solid Man' The vengeful soul of lost Long Lane A pub landlord's silent omen of death The uninvited guest at the Merchant Hotel Please note: The walking tour starts outside the Linen Hall Library on Donegall Square North in Belfast city centre, where your guide will be waiting for you Please arrive 10 minutes before the scheduled start time The tour will last two hours and cover around one and a half miles on mainly flat, even ground The route is fully accessible, but please inform us in advance of any mobility issues The tour ends at the Merchant Hotel on Waring Street in Belfast city centre The tour will go ahead in all weathers, so please dress accordingly and stay hydrated There are public toilets near the start and end points, and we can make a toilet stop approximately halfway through the…

Winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, Hadestown: The Musical is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories, that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone. Filmed live on stage in London's West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, Hadestown: The Musical invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.

Jenna Ortega is Klara, a solar-powered Artificial Friend chosen as companion to a seriously ill girl. As she encounters love, grief and the strange complexities of human behaviour, Klara discovers an extraordinary capacity for devotion. Taika Waititi directs this tender adaptation of Kazuo Ishiguro’s acclaimed novel. “Waititi’s distinctive vision perfectly complements Ishiguro’s poignant tale”: BFI London Film Festival In a near future transformed by genetic engineering and artificial intelligence, Klara is an Artificial Friend, a solar-powered android created to provide companionship to children. Chosen by the seriously ill Josie, she enters a family struggling with grief, fear and an uncertain future. As Klara observes the baffling complexities of human behaviour, her extraordinary loyalty and faith in the healing power of the sun lead her towards a profound understanding of love and sacrifice. Jenna Ortega stars alongside Amy Adams and Mia Tharia in Taika Waititi’s adaptation of Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro’s acclaimed novel, a tender and thought-provoking science-fiction story about what it means to be human.

Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone's trip to this remote paradise sideways.

Following the epic conclusion of the Netflix global phenomenon, Emmy-winning composers Kyle Dixon and Michael Stein (of the band S U R V I V E) return to the stage for the definitive live celebration of the entire saga. This 2026 tour offers a complete sonic retrospective, spanning all five seasons of the series. From the iconic 2016 opening theme to the climactic sounds of the recently released Season 5, Dixon and Stein bring their atmospheric scores to life. To elevate the performance into a fully immersive experience, they have partnered with renowned visual artist MFO (Marcel Weber). The new show features a minimal yet striking design of light and sculpted fog. Light takes on a physical presence through dreamy glows and violent, haunted movements, blurring the line between concert and cinema to make the Stranger Things atmosphere a truly tangible experience.

1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he's willing to sacrifice, who he's willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side. Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre, Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonising struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Dexys Midnight Runners burst out of Birmingham in the late 1970s with a fiercely original blend of soul, folk, and new wave energy. Fronted by Kevin Rowland, the band became best known for their global smash Come On Eileen, a track that perfectly captures their knack for mixing heartfelt storytelling with irresistible hooks. Never content to stand still, Dexys constantly reinvented their sound and image, earning a reputation as one of Britain’s most passionate and distinctive musical acts.

events.description: WEALTHY WOMEN are a 3-piece noise rock band based in San Francisco. Formed in 2024, the band spent the following year writing and ultimately recording their debut album at Antisleep Audio with producer Scott Evans (Thrice, Kowloon Walled City, Neurosis). They have been compared to the new wave of noise rock led by Chat Pile while also referencing progenitors of the genre such as Shellac and Helmet. Released in August 2026, the album CHILDREN confronts themes that loomed large in 2025: rising toxic masculinity, pervasive misinformation, and the senseless loss of life in multiple wars.

Celebrating the very best of our homegrown music, the NI Music Prize brings together artists, musicians and the wider music community for a special evening of live performances and awards, shining a spotlight on the remarkable music being made in and from Northern Ireland. The night will see the presentation of awards including Album of the Year, Single of the Year, Live Act of the Year, PRS for Music Creator of the Year, BBC Introducing in NI Artist of The Year and the Outstanding Contribution to Music Award, recognising artists at every stage of their careers and across a wide range of genres. More than an awards ceremony, the NI Music Prize is a celebration of Northern Ireland’s music scene, featuring a packed programme of live performances from some of the most exciting established and emerging artists working today. Produced by Oh Yeah Music Centre, the NI Music Prize has grown into a landmark annual event and a unique opportunity to experience the breadth, quality and diversity of Northern Irish music together on one stage. Join us at the Ulster Hall for a very special night celebrating the music and the people who make it.

Rising to prominence in the early 2000s, the Colorado-bred group built a devoted global following with their soul-searching sound and arena-sized yet deeply intimate songs. Their iconic debut album How to Save a Life became one of the best-selling digital debuts of all time, earning four GRAMMY nominations, multiple Billboard Top 10 hits and a 4x Platinum certification. ai.en: The Style Councillors, a tribute to The Style Council, play Limelight Complex in Belfast with the Bad Manners horn section. The show is for over-18s only.

events.description: AGMP Presents This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s AGMP presents THE STYLE COUNCILLORS The Style Councillors are the world’s one and only tribute to The Style Council. Formed in 2013 by Darren Fletcher (Paul Weller) and Steve Hayes (Mick Talbot), The Style Councillors have quickly built a loyal fanbase for the group which was Paul Weller’s home for the majority of the 1980’s and where he wrote some of his finest songs. Dani Clay (Dee C. Lee) and Craig Read (Steve White) are joined by the Bad Manners Horn Section and a stellar line up of musicians hell-bent on recreating the sound of The Style Council. After the dissolution of The Jam in 1982, Paul Weller joined forces with Mick Talbot, formerly of The Merton Parkas, Dexys Midnight Runners and The Bureau, to form The Style Council. The band released a string of succesful singles between 1983-1989 such as Speak Like a Child, Money-Go-Round, Long Hot Summer, My Ever Changing Moods, You’re The Best Thing, Shout To The Top, Walls Come Tumbling Down, A Solid Bond In Your Heart, Come To Milton Keynes, The Lodgers, Why I Went Missing, and more. This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

ai.en: AJJ, the American folk-punk band formed in Phoenix in 2004, plays at Black Box in Belfast. The band blends folk punk, anti-folk and experimental music.

events.description: AJJ, originally known as Andrew Jackson Jihad, is an American folk-punk band formed in 2004 in Phoenix, Arizona. The band is celebrated for its distinct blend of genres, including folk punk, anti-folk, and experimental music. With lyrics that often touch on themes of shyness, poverty, humanity, and politics, AJJ has carved out a unique space in the contemporary music scene. The founding members, singer and guitarist Sean Bonnette and bassist Ben Gallaty, have remained the only constants in the band’s lineup since its inception. Their first studio album, Candy Cigarettes & Cap Guns, was released in 2005, showcasing their early sound and lyrical depth. The album was well-received and marked the beginning of a prolific career.

ai.en: Elvana, an Elvis-fronted tribute to Nirvana, plays Mandela Hall in Belfast, mashing up Nirvana's catalogue with rockabilly and Elvis Presley songs.

events.description: ELVANA - THE WORLD'S FINEST ELVIS FRONTED TRIBUTE TO NIRVANA! From somewhere deep in the bowels of Disgraceland, the King of Rock & Roll steps out of the afterlife, plugs in, and takes the mic for the band that changed the ’90s forever. Elvis fronts Nirvana. No compromise. Just pure, electrified chaos. Blending the swagger of rockabilly with the raw punch of grunge, Elvana rips through Nirvana’s catalogue while smashing it together with the finest moments of Elvis Presley’s legacy. Expect overdriven riffs, hip-shaking grooves, loud guitars, louder screams, and the kind of mash-ups that feel wrong until they feel absolutely perfect. It smells like cheeseburgers and teen spirit, daddy-o. Described as “Bafflingly Brilliant” by The Guardian, “Absolutely f**king epic” by NME, and “The only band worth getting excited about this year” by Vice, Elvana have built a reputation as one of the wildest live experiences on the planet. Even Billy Idol joked that if Elvis were still around, he’d probably be covering Nirvana anyway. Two icons. One stage. Zero rules. If you haven’t seen Elvana yet, you’re missing out.If you have, you already know… and you’re probably checking tour dates right now. Stupid and contagious. In the absolute best way. 🎸🔥👑 AGE RESTRICTION: 18+ Only
